en.p: The function $f(x)=(x-1)(x-2)$ and a quartic function $g(x)$ with leading coefficient $1$ satisfy the following condition.

box: For every real number $a$, the values of $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to a}\frac{g(x)\times|f(x)|}{f(x)}$ and $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to a}\frac{|g(x)-f(x)|}{g(x)}$ both exist.
